name: hebbian-association-tracking
description: Track concept co-occurrence to suggest related contexts: 'Cells that fire together, wire together'. Complements TF-IDF by finding implicit connections between concepts.
steps: Initialize empty association graph: {(concept_a, concept_b): weight}
When concepts co-occur in same capture: reinforce(pair, weight=1.0, context)
Weight increases with repeated co-occurrence across captures
Retrieve related concepts: graph.walk_from(query, depth=2, min_weight)
Hybrid retrieval: combine TF-IDF similarity (0.7) + associations (0.3)
triggers: user mentions concept, suggest historically related concepts
TF-IDF finds similar text but misses implicit connections
need to find concepts mentioned in same contexts (different vocabulary)
building knowledge graphs from capture corpus
examples: Capture: 'docker compose yaml config' → reinforce(docker, compose), (docker, yaml), (compose, yaml)
Hybrid search: TF-IDF similarity 0.8 + association bonus 0.2 = 1.0
